report.incidentSummary: Starting at 13:40 IST (08:10 UTC) on 2026-09-17, UPI autopay mandate setup began failing for Gomti Bank account holders, dropping Gomti's mandate success rate from ~97% to ~52%. All other partner banks operated normally at ~96-97% success rates. Investigation confirmed that Gomti Bank's upstream e-mandate registration API began rejecting mandate creation requests with HTTP 422 error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded').
report.rootCauseStatement: Partner bank Gomti's upstream e-mandate API (bank-apis) began declining approximately 45% of mandate setup requests with HTTP 422 and error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') starting at 2026-09-17T08:10:02Z, isolated strictly to Gomti Bank accounts while all internal infrastructure, databases, and other partner bank integrations remained healthy.

hypotheses.cause: Partner bank Gomti's e-mandate registration API began declining mandate setup requests with HTTP 422 error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') starting at ~08:10 UTC, degrading Gomti mandate success to ~52% while all other banks functioned normally.
hypotheses.rationale: Mandate failures and bank-connector errors are isolated 100% to Gomti Bank (1,172 of 1,172 error logs). Error responses explicitly return HTTP 422 with payload {"code":"U16","message":"risk threshold exceeded"}. Gomti API latency did not spike and other banks were completely unaffected.

hypotheses.cause: Mandate-service configuration update CHG-48222 at 08:00 UTC or an unverified payload field change altered mandate parameter attributes, triggering Gomti's U16 risk threshold rule.
hypotheses.rationale: CHG-48222 was applied at 08:00:00 UTC strictly to increase npci.timeout_ms from 8s to 10s, 10 minutes prior to symptom onset. It did not alter mandate payload fields, and no other bank experienced errors or risk declines.

facts.statement: In mandate-service, mandate success rate fell exclusively for partner bank Gomti, dropping from ~97% to 75.69% at 08:10 UTC and stabilizing between 51% and 55%, while other partner banks (indus_valley, kaveri, northstar, sahyadri) maintained normal success rates of 96.2%–97.4%.
In bank-connector, bank_error_rate for Gomti surged from ~0.65% to 21.78% at 08:10 UTC and hovered between 41% and 48% through 10:25 UTC, while error rates for all other banks stayed below 1.0%.
Bank-connector p95 latency for Gomti remained steady between 1650 ms and 1850 ms (mean 1772 ms) across the investigation window, showing no latency degradation or timeout spike.

Starting at 08:10:02.145 UTC, bank-connector logged HTTP 422 responses from bank-apis for Gomti on POST /mandates with payload '{"code":"U16","message":"risk threshold exceeded"}', and mandate-service logged matching 'mandate failed: bank declined (U16 risk threshold exceeded)'.
Between 07:30 and 10:30 UTC, 100% of all 1,172 ERROR and FATAL log events in mandate-service and bank-connector were exclusively attributed to bank Gomti.

Database active connections (mean 165.6), lock wait times (mean 3.87 ms), and slow queries (mean 2.61/min) remained stable throughout 07:30 to 10:30 UTC, with zero database-related errors logged in mandate-service.
Configuration change CHG-48222 was applied to mandate-service at 08:00:00 UTC, adjusting npci.timeout_ms from 8000 ms to 10000 ms, 10 minutes before the first failure at 08:10:02 UTC.

inferences.statement: The failure is not caused by broad NPCI gateway degradation or internal infrastructure saturation, but by an isolated rule or threshold decline enforced by Gomti Bank's upstream API.
Configuration change CHG-48222 is coincidental and not the trigger of the U16 failures, as failures only began 10 minutes later and affected solely Gomti Bank rather than all NPCI-routed mandates.

assumptions.statement: Gomti Bank updated or tightened an internal risk, velocity, or mandate amount threshold on their backend around 08:10 UTC (13:40 IST) without prior notice.

timeline.event: CHG-48222 applied to mandate-service, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms.
First mandate registration decline logged for Gomti Bank with error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded').
Gomti Bank mandate success rate drops from 96.7% to 75.7% (and to ~52.6% by 08:15 UTC); bank-connector error rate for Gomti spikes to 21.8% and then ~43%.
Payments product manager reports incident INC-4557 observing overall mandate success drop to ~90%.

confidence.rationale: High confidence supported by complete error log concordance (100% of errors for bank=gomti returning HTTP 422 with U16), normal metrics across all other partner banks, and elimination of internal database or deployment issues.

gaps.description: bank_latency_p95_ms returned partial completeness due to telemetry datastore read limits.
gaps.impact: Low impact because the observed failure mode is explicit HTTP 422 error responses rather than latency degradation or timeouts.

gaps.description: Direct internal telemetry from Gomti Bank's upstream risk engine is unavailable.
gaps.impact: Requires external partner communication with Gomti Bank to confirm the exact policy rule or threshold trigger.

recommendedActions.action: Contact Gomti Bank partner integrations team to escalate the sudden surge in HTTP 422 U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') declines for e-mandates.
recommendedActions.rationale: Gomti Bank's API is rejecting ~45% of valid mandate registrations with error code U16.
recommendedActions.verification: Confirm with Gomti Bank engineering regarding their threshold rule change and observe Gomti mandate success rate return to baseline (~97%).

recommendedActions.action: Surface user-friendly UI feedback and recommend alternative bank or payment methods when Gomti Bank returns U16 declines.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevent repeated failed retries and user drop-off while Gomti resolves their risk threshold rule.
recommendedActions.verification: Check client telemetry that affected users receive actionable guidance instead of generic setup failure errors.

recommendedActions.action: Align api-gateway (5000ms) and mandate-service npci.timeout_ms (10000ms modified in CHG-48222) timeouts to prevent upstream gateway timeouts on slow NPCI calls.
recommendedActions.rationale: While not the cause of INC-4557, CHG-48222 introduced a timeout discrepancy where api-gateway will terminate requests before mandate-service times out.
recommendedActions.verification: Inspect service dependency timeout configurations and verify gateway timeouts do not spike during NPCI slow responses.

Furthermore, mandate-service logs contain zero database or transaction timeout errors; all 602 mandate-service errors from 08:10 UTC onwards were bank declines with 'U# risk threshold exceeded'.

observations.statement: Database active_connections remained steady throughout 07:30 to 10:30 UTC with a mean of 165.6 (min 158.9, max 173.2), showing no connection pool saturation starting at or around 08:10 UTC.

All 602 ERROR logs in mandate-service between 07:30 and 10:30 UTC (starting at 08:10:02.145Z) are for 'mandate <ref> failed: bank declined (U# risk threshold exceeded)'.

Database contention, lock wait times, connection pool exhaustion, and database transaction timeouts are ruled out as the cause of autopay mandate setup failures. The failures are bank-side declines due to risk threshold exceptions.

findings.summary: At 08:00:00 UTC (10 minutes before the reported incident start), config change CHG-48222 was applied to mandate-service, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms. Because api-gateway enforces a 5000ms timeout on mandate-service, any mandate call taking longer than 5000ms will time out at api-gateway. Past incidents with NPCI degradation (PIR-1624, PIR-2008) caused broad drops across all banks to ~40%, whereas current success is ~90%, suggesting latency-tail timeouts or a single slow partner bank.

observations.statement: At 2026-09-17T08:00:00.000Z (10 minutes prior to symptom onset at ~08:10 UTC), config change CHG-48222 was applied to mandate-service by v.rao, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms.

On 2026-09-16T09:57:19.248Z, config change CHG-48523 raised autoscaling.max_replicas from 12 to 17 on bank-connector; no code deployments occurred on bank-connector or mandate-service in the scope window.
api-gateway connects to mandate-service synchronously with a 5000ms timeout and 0 retries. mandate-service connects to npci with an external API call and to bank-connector with an 8000ms timeout.

Increasing npci.timeout_ms to 10000ms in mandate-service created or exacerbated an upstream timeout mismatch with api-gateway (5000ms timeout). Any slow NPCI mandate call taking over 5000ms will be terminated by api-gateway before mandate-service times out.

Historical incidents PIR-2008 and PIR-1624 both involved NPCI e-mandate gateway degradation causing sharp drops in mandate success across all banks (e.g., down to 40%), whereas current incident reports ~90% success for a subset of users.

# Investigation report: Autopay setup failing for some users

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.88 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
Starting at 13:40 IST (08:10 UTC) on 2026-09-17, UPI autopay mandate setup began failing for Gomti Bank account holders, dropping Gomti's mandate success rate from ~97% to ~52%. All other partner banks operated normally at ~96-97% success rates. Investigation confirmed that Gomti Bank's upstream e-mandate registration API began rejecting mandate creation requests with HTTP 422 error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded').

**Root cause:** Partner bank Gomti's upstream e-mandate API (bank-apis) began declining approximately 45% of mandate setup requests with HTTP 422 and error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') starting at 2026-09-17T08:10:02Z, isolated strictly to Gomti Bank accounts while all internal infrastructure, databases, and other partner bank integrations remained healthy.

## Hypotheses
1. **Partner bank Gomti's e-mandate registration API began declining mandate setup requests with HTTP 422 error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') starting at ~08:10 UTC, degrading Gomti mandate success to ~52% while all other banks functioned normally.** — `bank-apis`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.88, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_2, ev_8, ev_11, ev_16, ev_17, ev_18] · Contradicting: none
   - Mandate failures and bank-connector errors are isolated 100% to Gomti Bank (1,172 of 1,172 error logs). Error responses explicitly return HTTP 422 with payload {"code":"U16","message":"risk threshold exceeded"}. Gomti API latency did not spike and other banks were completely unaffected.
2. **Mandate-service configuration update CHG-48222 at 08:00 UTC or an unverified payload field change altered mandate parameter attributes, triggering Gomti's U16 risk threshold rule.** — `mandate-service`, config_change, confidence 0.12, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_7] · Contradicting: [ev_11, ev_16, ev_17, ev_18]
   - CHG-48222 was applied at 08:00:00 UTC strictly to increase npci.timeout_ms from 8s to 10s, 10 minutes prior to symptom onset. It did not alter mandate payload fields, and no other bank experienced errors or risk declines.

## Facts
- In mandate-service, mandate success rate fell exclusively for partner bank Gomti, dropping from ~97% to 75.69% at 08:10 UTC and stabilizing between 51% and 55%, while other partner banks (indus_valley, kaveri, northstar, sahyadri) maintained normal success rates of 96.2%–97.4%. [ev_2]
- In bank-connector, bank_error_rate for Gomti surged from ~0.65% to 21.78% at 08:10 UTC and hovered between 41% and 48% through 10:25 UTC, while error rates for all other banks stayed below 1.0%. [ev_8]
- Bank-connector p95 latency for Gomti remained steady between 1650 ms and 1850 ms (mean 1772 ms) across the investigation window, showing no latency degradation or timeout spike. [ev_11]
- Starting at 08:10:02.145 UTC, bank-connector logged HTTP 422 responses from bank-apis for Gomti on POST /mandates with payload '{"code":"U16","message":"risk threshold exceeded"}', and mandate-service logged matching 'mandate failed: bank declined (U16 risk threshold exceeded)'. [ev_9, ev_16, ev_17]
- Between 07:30 and 10:30 UTC, 100% of all 1,172 ERROR and FATAL log events in mandate-service and bank-connector were exclusively attributed to bank Gomti. [ev_18]
- Database active connections (mean 165.6), lock wait times (mean 3.87 ms), and slow queries (mean 2.61/min) remained stable throughout 07:30 to 10:30 UTC, with zero database-related errors logged in mandate-service. [ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_12]
- Configuration change CHG-48222 was applied to mandate-service at 08:00:00 UTC, adjusting npci.timeout_ms from 8000 ms to 10000 ms, 10 minutes before the first failure at 08:10:02 UTC. [ev_1, ev_7]

## Inferences
- The failure is not caused by broad NPCI gateway degradation or internal infrastructure saturation, but by an isolated rule or threshold decline enforced by Gomti Bank's upstream API. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_8, ev_11, ev_16, ev_17, ev_18]
- Configuration change CHG-48222 is coincidental and not the trigger of the U16 failures, as failures only began 10 minutes later and affected solely Gomti Bank rather than all NPCI-routed mandates. [ev_1, ev_2, ev_7, ev_18]

## Assumptions
- Gomti Bank updated or tightened an internal risk, velocity, or mandate amount threshold on their backend around 08:10 UTC (13:40 IST) without prior notice.

## Timeline
- **2026-09-17 13:30 IST (08:00:00 UTC)** CHG-48222 applied to mandate-service, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms. [ev_1, ev_7]
- **2026-09-17 13:40:02 IST (08:10:02.145 UTC)** First mandate registration decline logged for Gomti Bank with error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded'). [ev_9, ev_17, ev_18]
- **2026-09-17 13:40–13:45 IST (08:10–08:15 UTC)** Gomti Bank mandate success rate drops from 96.7% to 75.7% (and to ~52.6% by 08:15 UTC); bank-connector error rate for Gomti spikes to 21.8% and then ~43%. [ev_2, ev_8]
- **2026-09-17 14:45 IST (09:15:00 UTC)** Payments product manager reports incident INC-4557 observing overall mandate success drop to ~90%. [ev_2]

## Confidence
0.88: High confidence supported by complete error log concordance (100% of errors for bank=gomti returning HTTP 422 with U16), normal metrics across all other partner banks, and elimination of internal database or deployment issues.

## Gaps
- bank_latency_p95_ms returned partial completeness due to telemetry datastore read limits. (impact: Low impact because the observed failure mode is explicit HTTP 422 error responses rather than latency degradation or timeouts.)
- Direct internal telemetry from Gomti Bank's upstream risk engine is unavailable. (impact: Requires external partner communication with Gomti Bank to confirm the exact policy rule or threshold trigger.)

  - Verify: Inspect service dependency timeout configurations and verify gateway timeouts do not spike during NPCI slow responses.
